### ST-085

**JSON report with a versioned schema**

*As a **CI maintainer**, I want **a machine-readable report of every run**, so that **I can build tooling on top of SmartTest**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S9 | O01, §25.2 | [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] JSON report includes change analysis, decision, executions, coverage scope and timings
- [x] Published JSON Schema with `schemaVersion`
- [x] Skipped-by-selection and executed tests are separate collections

---

### ST-086

**Self-contained HTML report**

*As a **developer**, I want **an attractive, offline HTML report**, so that **I can review and share results easily**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 8 | S9 | O02, §25.3 | [ST-085](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-085) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Single file, no network requests; sections: summary, change analysis, selection with reasons, executions, coverage, performance
- [x] Follows the design system (dark/light, reduced motion, WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation)
- [x] Untrusted strings (paths, logs, test names) are escaped; no script injection possible
- [x] Generated in < 2 s for the medium benchmark repo

---

### ST-087

**JUnit XML export**

*As a **CI maintainer**, I want **JUnit XML output**, so that **existing CI test dashboards keep working**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 2 | S9 | O03 | [ST-051](EXE-test-execution.md#st-051) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Valid JUnit XML for executed tests
- [x] Selection-skipped tests are optional (`--junit-include-skipped`) and marked with a skip reason, never as passed
- [x] Validated against a JUnit XSD in tests

### ST-088

**Coverage ingestion with explicit scope**

*As a **developer**, I want **coverage from my runner ingested and labelled full or selected**, so that **partial coverage is never mistaken for project coverage**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟧 Should | 5 | S9 | K01, K10, §16.2 | [ST-049](EXE-test-execution.md#st-049), [ST-050](EXE-test-execution.md#st-050) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Ingests istanbul JSON / lcov from Jest and Vitest
- [x] Every coverage figure is labelled `full` or `selected`; they are never merged
- [x] `smarttest coverage` prints the latest coverage with scope and age

---

### ST-089

**Impact explanations in reports**

*As a **reviewer**, I want **selection reasons visible in reports**, so that **I can audit a run without re-running commands**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S9 | O05, §11.6 | [ST-062](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-062), [ST-085](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-085) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Each selected test lists its reasons; skipped tests list skip reasons
- [x] Fallbacks and mandatory triggers are highlighted
- [x] Analysis completeness is shown at the top

---

### ST-090

**Report integrity validation**

*As a **team lead**, I want **automated checks that reports never overstate results**, so that **our quality signals are honest**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S10 | O09, §25.4, §32.2 | [ST-086](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-086), [ST-087](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-087) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Integrity suite asserts: skipped ≠ passed, cached ≠ fresh, partial ≠ full coverage, partial analysis is flagged
- [x] Runs in CI for every report format
- [x] Violations fail the build
